title: Password Strength
content: Create password input with strength indicator. Input field: password type with visibility toggle (Eye/EyeOff). Strength meter: colored bar below input (red-yellow-green gradient). Strength calculation: check length, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, special characters. Requirements checklist: show each requirement with check/X icon that updates live. Show/hide password: toggle to reveal text.

variants.simple: Create password input with colored strength meter bar below.
variants.detailed: Create password input with strength indicator. Input field: password type with visibility toggle (Eye/EyeOff). Strength meter: colored bar below input (red-yellow-green gradient). Strength calculation: check length, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, special characters. Requirements checklist: show each requirement with check/X icon that updates live. Show/hide password: toggle to reveal text.
variants.advanced: Create password input with comprehensive strength indicator and requirements checklist. Input field: type="password" with visibility toggle button (Eye when hidden, EyeOff when visible) positioned absolute right-3, toggle switches type between "password" and "text". Input styling: standard form input with focus ring, pr-10 for toggle button space. Strength meter: colored bar below input (h-2 rounded-full), 4-5 segments or continuous gradient. Calculate strength score (0-4): +1 for length ≥8, +1 for uppercase letter, +1 for lowercase letter, +1 for number, +1 for special character (!@#$%^&*). Colors: 0=gray (empty), 1=red (Very Weak), 2=orange (Weak), 3=yellow (Fair), 4=green (Strong), 5=green (Very Strong). Width: animate width from 0% to score*20-25%. Strength labels: text below meter showing current strength ("Weak", "Strong", etc.) in matching color. Requirements checklist: vertical list below meter showing each requirement with icon that updates live. Met: green CheckCircle icon, text-green-600, line-through optional. Unmet: gray Circle or X icon, text-gray-500. Requirements: "At least 8 characters", "One uppercase letter (A-Z)", "One lowercase letter (a-z)", "One number (0-9)", "One special character (!@#$%^&*)". Minimum requirements: visually distinguish which are required vs recommended (asterisk or "Required" label). Real-time feedback: update strength and checklist onChange as user types. Tips: contextual suggestions below checklist for improving password ("Add numbers to increase strength"). Generate password: optional "Generate strong password" button that creates random 16+ char password meeting all requirements, copies to clipboard, shows in input. Confirm password: optional second field with real-time match validation ("Passwords match" with CheckCircle or "Passwords do not match" with XCircle). Breach check: optional integration with haveibeenpwned API (hash-based, privacy-safe), show warning if password found in data breaches. Accessibility: aria-describedby linking input to requirements list, announce strength changes.
